human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Stabilize the narrow product surface with deterministic fixtures, mocked route tests, timeout/error coverage and a labelled demo fallback artifact.
human_pressure.why_now: A hackathon demo must fail honestly and predictably; correctness matters more than feature count.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.
red_lines: No browser E2E framework unless already present and trivial.

machine_core.goal: Create a small fixture set and tests covering provider mapping, route orchestration, gap rules, error semantics and demo-fixture labeling.
red_lines: No browser E2E framework unless already present and trivial.
invariants: Tests protect product claims and failure honesty.

steps.title: Create minimal fixtures
details: Use small captured/hand-normalized provider-shaped fixtures without secrets.

steps.title: Test route orchestration
details: Assert missing/failed metrics do not create a gap.

steps.title: Test golden rule boundaries
details: Keep focused tests only; no broad test framework expansion.

reject_if: Work expands beyond the declared file scope.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
